zh-CN:
remote-agent：在 tmux 中托管与操控本机 AI 编程 CLI

用法：
{agentLines}
  remote-agent session OPERATION           创建、查看与操控托管会话（见 session help）
  remote-agent models [{agents}]           查看这台电脑可用的模型、推理强度与默认配置
  remote-agent schedule OPERATION          管理持久定时任务（见 schedule help）
  remote-agent account join|secret|status  将本机连接到账户服务器
  remote-agent update [check|status|auto]  更新 daemon（见 update help）
  remote-agent doctor [{agents}]           检查已安装的 CLI 是否与 remote-agent 兼容
  remote-agent daemon [flags]              在前台运行 daemon
  remote-agent --version                   查看产品版本与源码修订
en:
remote-agent: operate native AI coding CLIs running in tmux

Usage:
{agentLines}
  remote-agent session OPERATION           create, inspect and control sessions (session help)
  remote-agent models [{agents}]       list models, efforts and defaults on this computer
  remote-agent schedule OPERATION          manage persistent timed Agent messages (schedule help)
  remote-agent account join|secret|status  connect this machine to a server
  remote-agent update [check|status|auto]  update the daemon (update help)
  remote-agent doctor [{agents}]       check that installed CLIs work with remote-agent
  remote-agent daemon [flags]              run the daemon in the foreground
  remote-agent --version                   show product version and source revision

agentLines.example: remote-agent codex [codex args]          start a Codex session here and attach to it

notes: remote-agent --help 顶层命令行用法说明；agentLines 为已注册 CLI 直启命令行，agents 为竖线分隔的 CLI 列表。
